text: Rate, tag and search your photos — privately, on your own computers. A few quick choices and you're done; nothing is scanned until you finish.
new_text: sortandpost.photos helps photographers take their photo library from 'living on my hard drive' to organized and posted for people to see. sortandpost.photos is built with privacy by design.
